claims.claim: Governor Gavin Newsom commuted the sentences of California's 548 death row inmates and called capital punishment morally objectionable.
claims.episode_span: Governor Gavin Newsom commuted the sentences of California’s 548 people on death row
claims.source_title: Newsom Commutes the Sentences of California’s 548 Death Row Inmates
claims.supporting_quote: Gov. Gavin Newsom, who is considering a run for president, called capital punishment morally objectionable.

claims.claim: California has not executed anyone for 20 years, and the 548 sentences are about a quarter of death sentences nationwide.
claims.episode_span: California has not executed anyone for 20 years
claims.source_title: Newsom Commutes the Sentences of California’s 548 Death Row Inmates
claims.supporting_quote: Though California hasn’t executed anyone for 20 years, that represents about a quarter of death sentences nationwide.

claims.claim: Austin Sarat wrote that emptying California's death row frees hundreds from the threat of execution.
claims.episode_span: the decision to empty the state’s death row frees hundreds of people from the threat of execution
claims.source_title: We’ve just seen a transformative moment in America’s death penalty history | Austin Sarat
claims.supporting_quote: Not only will it free hundreds of people from the threat of execution, but coming from a politician seemingly looking to run for the presidency, it sends an important signal that America’s attachment to capital punishment is weakening

claims.claim: Mark Carney's budget approach is to borrow billions now for major projects, with debt exposure if investments fail.
claims.episode_span: Ottawa can borrow billions now for major projects meant to jump-start the economy
claims.source_title: Carney's bet on economic growth — and the risks that come with it
claims.supporting_quote: Mark Carney believes he can borrow billions now to invest into major projects and jump start the Canadian economy. If those investments don't pay off, Canada's debt load leaves it exposed to other, new risks.

claims.claim: CBC reports the federal budget charts a path to $157 billion in annual defence spending by 2030.
claims.episode_span: a path to 157 billion dollars in annual spending by 2030
claims.source_title: Federal budget maps out defence spending surge, but questions remain over NATO target
claims.supporting_quote: The federal budget charts a path to $157 billion in annual defence spending by 2030, bringing Canada closer to NATO's five per cent target.

claims.claim: The Globe and Mail reports no further progress toward the military spending target beyond 2027-28.
claims.episode_span: no further progress toward the military spending target beyond 2027-28
claims.source_title: Ottawa eases off defence spending increases despite NATO commitments
claims.supporting_quote: No further progress toward military spending target beyond 2027-28

claims.claim: Bloc Québécois, NDP and Green leaders said the budget was disappointing and did not do enough on affordability.
claims.episode_span: the budget was disappointing, lacked substance and did not do enough on affordability
claims.source_title: Opposition leaders react to 2026 budget
claims.supporting_quote: The leaders of the Bloc Québécois, NDP and Green Party say the federal budget was disappointing, lacked substance and didn’t do enough to address affordability.

claims.claim: The cultural sector receives a $4-billion boost in the federal budget.
claims.episode_span: a 4 billion dollar cultural-sector boost
claims.source_title: Cultural sector gets $4-billion boost in bid to defend national sovereignty
claims.supporting_quote: Funding will support national museums, art galleries, journalism and a new national digital library, among other initiatives

claims.claim: Judge Tanya Chutkan blocked construction of Trump's triumphal arch for 14 days just after a federal panel approved it.
claims.episode_span: a federal judge blocked construction for 14 days
claims.source_title: A judge blocks construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval
claims.supporting_quote: The Trump administration hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. But just after midnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.

claims.claim: The NCPC approved a 250-foot arch beside Arlington National Cemetery, and Trump has described it as a military complex for drones, snipers and ammunition.
claims.episode_span: approved a 250-foot arch, inspired by Paris’s Arc de Triomphe, beside Arlington National Cemetery
claims.source_title: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive 'triumphal arch'
claims.supporting_quote: The National Capital Planning Commission (NCPC) had voted earlier on Thursday to approve the project - a 250-foot-tall arch inspired by Paris' Arc de Triomphe.

claims.claim: One officer was killed and three wounded, a civilian was injured, and police shot the gunman dead on a bus in Lakewood, Colorado.
claims.episode_span: One police officer was killed and three were wounded after a man opened fire on officers
claims.source_title: 1 Officer Is Killed and 3 Are Wounded in Shootout on Suburban Denver Bus
claims.supporting_quote: A civilian was also injured after a man opened fire on officers who pursued him onto a bus in Lakewood, Colo., the authorities said. The gunman was shot dead by the police.

claims.claim: A Montreal public health study of 8,500 adults found online gambling more than doubled among men 18 to 34, while 39 per cent of adults gambled in 2025, 15 per cent fewer than in 2018 and 2002.
claims.episode_span: Thirty-nine per cent said they had gambled in some form in 2025, 15 per cent fewer than in 2018 and in 2002.
claims.source_title: Online gambling more than doubles among young Montreal men, study finds
claims.supporting_quote: The study surveyed 8,500 Montreal adults and found 39 per cent said they had engaged in some form of gambling in 2025, 15 per cent fewer than in 2018 and 2002.

claims.claim: Seventy-five per cent of those surveyed wished there were no advertisements for gambling sites.
claims.episode_span: 75 per cent of those surveyed wished there were no advertisements at all for gambling sites
claims.source_title: Online gambling more than doubles among young Montreal men, study finds
claims.supporting_quote: The study found 75 per cent of those surveyed said they wished there were no advertisements at all for gambling sites.

claims.claim: The Guardian reports Democrats lead the House 253 to 157 with 25 races uncalled, and Nithya Raman won the Los Angeles mayor's race over Karen Bass.
claims.episode_span: Democrats lead Republicans 253 to 157 in the House with 25 races still uncalled
claims.source_title: US midterm elections 2026 live: Democrats exceed 250 House seats as blue wave sweeping Congress grows
claims.supporting_quote: Democrats are now leading Republicans 253 to 157, with 25 races left to call, as a number of GOP representatives felt the weight of the blue wave that has swept their party out of power.

claims.claim: United Airlines will cancel all remaining flights to Tulum starting in January, while several other carriers keep routes.
claims.episode_span: United Airlines will cancel all its remaining flights to Tulum starting in January
claims.source_title: United Airlines cancels all its remaining flights to Tulum starting in January
claims.supporting_quote: While United joins a long list of major carriers that have dropped Tulum flights, it's not as though the Caribbean Coast destination has become inaccessible. Air Canada, WestJet, Air Transat, Viva and Mexicana maintain their Tulum routes.

claims.claim: School enrollment was expected to fall by 2 million children by 2030, and education experts say deportations are worsening that.

claims.supporting_quote: School enrollment was already expected to plunge by 2 million kids by 2030. Education experts say deporting immigrant families, many with school-age children, is making the crisis worse.
